_comment: Dead hangs / strength & ageing reel. Source paths point at the raw uploads; repoint them at the clips (IMG_0123.MP4, IMG_2313.MOV, IMG_2303.MOV, IMG_2597.MOV) to re-render.
title: VEXON · It's more than just holding on · Storyboard
music_note: Cut to the inspiration reel's track (~131 BPM). Exported silent; start the song on its first downbeat at 0:00.

shots.name: HOOK
shots.note: Wide: coach watching a timed hang. Words slam in on beats 0/2/4 with the house font flicker, then hold.

shots.name: HOOK b
shots.note: Hard cut on the bar line to a tighter angle; title holds so it can be absorbed.

shots.name: IT'S:
shots.note: Soft diagonal wipe with orange edge. 'IT'S:' rises in alone, centre frame.

shots.name: Q1 How long
shots.text: How long can you maintain your hold?
shots.note: Vertical push. 'IT'S:' glides up into a header and stays. Stopwatch phone visible bottom-left.

shots.name: Q2 Controlled
shots.text: Can you maintain a comfortable, controlled position?
shots.note: Soft wipe. Relaxed, steady hang; slow pull-out.

shots.name: Q3 One hand
shots.text: Does one hand fatigue noticeably faster?
shots.note: Push. Slow push-in toward the grip.

shots.name: Q4 Endurance
shots.text: Is your endurance improving with consistent training?
shots.note: Soft wipe back to the long timed hang, tighter angle.

shots.name: KEY MESSAGE
shots.text: Maintaining strength and physical function helps support independence as you age.
shots.note: Slow dip through navy. Lines rise in slowly; orange box on 'independence' lands on the next bar.

shots.name: FINAL a
shots.text: A dead hang is one small piece of the picture.
shots.note: Dissolve. He finishes the hang and steps away.

shots.name: FINAL b
shots.note: Push to the 'MEASURE WHAT MATTERS' banner shot. Large type under the banner; orange box on 'MATTERS'.

shots.name: END SLOT
shots.note: Slow dissolve to clean navy. Logo space; client adds the logo manually.
